policy.district_use: Ask the district where the business/service transaction occurred so HariMaga can expose the relevant CAA District Unit contact.
policy.time_note: CAA FAQ states that written complaints seeking redress should be supported by relevant documents and forwarded within the time specified by the Act; the FAQ currently states within 3 months.
policy.safety: Do not invent a business remedy, legal outcome, or compensation amount.
